mapper.sql: p.target_table='console_operation_audit' and p.archive_enabled and p.retention_days > 0 and p.batch_size > 0

a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and a.aggregate_type='NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY' and a.aggregate_id in ( select 'WEBHOOK:'||id from batch.webhook_delivery_log where tenant_id=r.tenant_id and terminal_event_key=r.event_key union all select 'RULE:'||id from batch.notification_delivery_log where tenant_id=r.tenant_id and terminal_event_key=r.event_key union all select 'PUSH:'||id from batch.console_push_job_delivery where tenant_id=r.tenant_id and terminal_event_key=r.event_key)

r.created_at < and not exists ( select 1 from batch.webhook_delivery_log d where d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and d.terminal_event_key=r.event_key and (d.delivery_status <> 'SUCCESS' or d.next_retry_at is not null or d.delivery_claim_token is not null or d.delivery_claim_until is not null or d.created_at >= )) and not exists ( select 1 from batch.notification_delivery_log d where d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and d.terminal_event_key=r.event_key and (d.delivery_status <> 'SUCCESS' or d.next_retry_at is not null or d.delivery_claim_token is not null or d.delivery_claim_until is not null or d.created_at >= )) and not exists ( select 1 from batch.console_push_job_delivery d where d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and d.terminal_event_key=r.event_key and ((d.record_type='DEVICE' and d.delivery_status not in ('ACCEPTED','GONE')) or d.next_retry_at is not null or d.delivery_claim_token is not null or d.delivery_claim_until is not null or d.created_at >= )) and not exists ( select 1 from batch.console_operation_audit a where and a.created_at >= )
and (p.cleanup_enabled or not exists ( select 1 from archive.workflow_terminal_notification_receipt_archive c where c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and c.event_key=r.event_key))
mapper.select: select r.tenant_id,r.event_key from batch.workflow_terminal_notification_receipt r join batch.archive_policy p on p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id where r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and and order by r.created_at,r.event_key limit least(#{limit},( select batch_size from batch.archive_policy where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and target_table='console_operation_audit'))

select p.cleanup_enabled from batch.workflow_terminal_notification_receipt r join batch.archive_policy p on p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id where r.tenant_id=#{candidate.tenantId} and r.event_key=#{candidate.eventKey} and and for update of r
mapper.insert: insert into select h.* from h where on conflict do nothing
mapper.select:
select count(*) from h left join c on c.tenant_id=h.tenant_id
and c.event_key=h.event_key and c.id=h.id
where and to_jsonb(h) is distinct from to_jsonb(c)
